the optimization and integration of cultural tourism resources can enrich the cultural connotation and core value of regional tourism.

regional tourism can be optimized by the integration of cultural tourism resources, which will enrich the cultural connotation, strengthen the core value and re-construct the characterization of regional culture.

the Hefei Economic zone can be developed into an area of cultural tourism by exploring and optimizing the local cultural tourism resources, and by integrating and developing the cultural tourism resources in the region.

the optimization of the spatial pattern in regional tourism and the integration of cultural resources should not only be based on the regional cultural resources,but also be based on the characteristics of the regional culture and the regional tourism resources.

the cultural resources of the Hefei Economic zone should be integrated and the regional tourism resources should be optimized,so as to make the regional tourism more competitive.
